name: Warlord's Hold
description: A fortress carved into the wall of the deepest rift on the Cracked Plains. Once a Warden outpost guarding a sealed vault, it was seized six months ago by the warlord Drask and his bandit army. The Hold is built vertically — battlements and a war room above, a great hall at ground level, and prison cells and a sealed vault below. The sounds of steel on stone and barked orders echo through the carved corridors.

rooms.name: Great Hall
rooms.description: The main hall of the Hold, carved from the living rock of the rift wall. Massive stone pillars support a vaulted ceiling thirty feet overhead, and torches burn in iron sconces along the walls. Drask's banner — a clenched fist on black — hangs above a stone dais at the far end. The floor is scarred from years of heavy boots and dragged prisoners. A passage leads south to the upper gallery, and a dark stairway descends into the fortress depths. Above, a steep climb leads back up to the cracked plains.

rooms.name: Guard Hall
rooms.description: A low-ceilinged barracks carved into the north wall of the fortress. Crude bunks line both sides, with weapon racks between them — most half-empty, the arms distributed to Drask's troops. A cooking fire smolders in a stone-lined pit, filling the room with greasy smoke. The guards rotate in shifts, and there are always fresh ones here.

rooms.name: Trophy Room
rooms.description: Drask's lieutenant keeps this room as a monument to conquest. Shields, banners, and weapons taken from defeated foes line the walls — many bearing the Warden sigil. A heavy oak table serves as both desk and dining surface, covered in maps and half-eaten food. The lieutenant sits here when not patrolling, studying Drask's campaign plans.

rooms.description: A stone gallery connected to the great hall to the north through a short passage. Arrow slits in the outer wall admit thin shafts of daylight from the rift outside. The gallery connects the armory to the west with the battlements to the east, and a final stair climbs to Drask's war room above.

rooms.name: Battlements
rooms.description: The Hold's upper defense — a narrow stone walkway carved into the outer rift wall, open to the sky on one side. A waist-high parapet protects against the sheer drop into the rift below. Crossbow emplacements are positioned at intervals, and signal torches stand ready for lighting. The wind howls through the gap, carrying the sounds of the rift up from the darkness below.

rooms.name: Drask's War Room
rooms.description: The highest chamber in the Hold, carved from the very top of the rift wall. A massive stone table dominates the center, covered in hand-drawn maps, campaign markers, and stolen Warden documents. The walls are hung with the banners of every settlement Drask has raided. A single window — more of a slash in the rock — looks out over the cracked plateau far below. This is where the warlord plans, commands, and waits.

rooms.name: Underhall
rooms.description: Below the great hall, the Hold descends into older construction — smooth Warden stonework, not the rough-hewn tunnels above. The corridor is narrow and low, with guttering torches spaced far apart. The air is damp and cold. Cells branch off to the north, and the south end terminates at a massive iron door bearing the Warden seal — the vault, still locked after all these centuries.

interactables.label: Sealed Vault Door
interactables.description: A massive iron door bearing the Warden seal. A keyhole shaped like a clenched fist is set into the lock — clearly, this was modified by Drask's forces. The original Warden lock has been replaced.

actionData.successMessage: You press Drask's War-Key into the fist-shaped lock. It turns with a grinding click, and the massive iron door swings inward on ancient hinges, revealing the vault beyond.
actionData.failureMessage: The lock requires a key shaped like a clenched fist — Drask's personal insignia.

rooms.name: Prison Cells
rooms.description: A row of iron-barred cells carved into the rock. Most are empty now — Drask prefers to ransom or conscript his prisoners rather than keep them. One cell still holds a skeleton in rusted chains, a remnant of the Hold's original Warden garrison. War hounds patrol the corridor, trained to savage anyone who doesn't wear Drask's brand.

rooms.name: Warden Vault
rooms.description: Behind the sealed door lies the Hold's deepest secret — a Warden vault, its walls lined with faintly glowing glyphs. Stone shelves hold the remnants of Warden artifacts, most already looted by Drask's forces. But the real prize is in the center: a reinforced iron chest still sealed with warding runes, too powerful for Drask to crack. Whatever the Wardens locked away here, it was important enough to build an entire fortress around.

interactables.label: Sealed Warden Chest
interactables.description: A reinforced iron chest covered in still-active warding runes. The lid resists opening, but the lock's power has weakened over centuries — with effort, it gives way.

npcs.description: A massive warrior stripped to the waist, covered in ritual scars and war paint. Drask recruits his berserkers from the most violent offenders — criminals, deserters, men with nothing to lose. They fight with twin axes and no regard for their own safety, working themselves into a frenzy before each engagement.

npcs.name: Warlord Drask
npcs.description: The warlord of the Cracked Plains — a towering man in dark iron plate, his face hidden behind a helm shaped like a clenched fist. Drask was a Warden captain before he went rogue, taking his company into the wastes and building a bandit empire. He fights with a massive cleaver that no ordinary soldier could lift one-handed. He has been excavating the Hold's lower levels, searching for something the Wardens sealed away — and the seal shard he wears around his neck suggests he found it.
